tools.name: subtensor_search
tools.description: Search across all Subtensor pallets, events, calls, storage, constants, and errors by keyword.

tools.name: subtensor_lookup
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific pallet, event, call, storage item, constant, error, SCALE type, RPC method, protocol account, or EVM precompile. Accepts URN identifiers with optional #field.path drilling.

urn.description: URN identifier (e.g., 'subtensor:event:SubtensorModule.StakeAdded', 'subtensor:storage:System.Account#data.free', 'subtensor:api:SwapRuntimeApi.sim_swap_tao_for_alpha', 'subtensor:account:SubtensorModule.SubtensorPalletId#64', 'subtensor:precompile:StakingV2'). `subtensor:runtime_api:...` is accepted as an alias for `subtensor:api:...`. Supports field-path drilling with # for event/call/storage/type items (for account items, #fragment is a sub-index instead). Alternative to type+pallet+name. Takes precedence if both provided.

type.description: What kind of item to look up

name.description: Item name (e.g., 'SubtensorModule', 'StakeAdded', 'add_stake', 'AccountId32', 'pruning', 'pow-faucet') or type ID number. For type="account": the declaring key ('SubtensorModule.SubtensorPalletId'). For type="precompile": a name ('StakingV2') or 0x address.

pallet.description: Pallet name — required for event/call/storage/constant/error lookups (e.g., 'SubtensorModule')

address.description: For type="account": an SS58 address to identify. Returns which protocol account it is, including the sub-index, or reports that it is an ordinary wallet.

sub.description: For type="account": derive a sub-account. A number is a netuid or crowdloan id; a string is an 8-byte tag such as "beta/esc". Index 0 collapses onto the base address.

include.description: For pallet lookup: filter to a specific item type with descriptions

include_history.description: Include full argument signatures for each version range (events/calls only)

language.description: Field name casing for your language. TypeScript shows camelCase (tickLow), others show snake_case (tick_low). Overrides session preference.

preferences.description: Preferences handle from subtensor_preferences(action="set"). Carries language/node_url/node_type without a session. Explicit arguments on this call take precedence over the handle.

tools.name: subtensor_list
tools.description: Browse items by category: pallets, events, calls, storage, constants, errors, types, runtime APIs, RPC methods, protocol accounts, EVM precompiles, mechanisms, workflows, hyperparameters, cli_flags, build_features, chain_specs, or env_vars.

pallet.description: Pallet name — required for events/calls/storage/constants/errors (e.g., 'SubtensorModule'). For category='rpc_methods' this filters by RPC namespace instead (e.g., 'state', 'subtensor').

kind.description: For types: filter by type kind

role.description: Filter calls by required role (only applies when category=calls)

context.description: For cli_flags/build_features: filter by usage context

flag_category.description: For cli_flags: filter by flag category (chain, sync, networking, rpc, metrics, runtime, subtensor)

tools.name: subtensor_explore
tools.description: Explore relationships, version history, removed items, changelogs, and migration guides between runtime versions.

type.description: Item type — for relationships (event/call/storage/error), for removed (all/pallet/event/call/storage/constant/error)

version.description: For versions: look up a specific version

tools.name: subtensor_explain
tools.description: Understand Bittensor concepts, workflows, mechanisms, runtime APIs, runtime errors, extrinsic format, or get code examples.

name.description: Topic-specific name: concept name ('staking'), workflow ID ('add-stake'), mechanism ID ('yuma-consensus'), runtime API name ('NeuronInfoRuntimeApi'), or item name for examples

item_type.description: For examples: type of item to generate code for

language.description: For examples: filter to one language (overrides session preference)

enum_slug.description: For runtime_errors: get a specific error enum

preferences.description: Preferences handle from subtensor_preferences(action="set"). Carries language/node_url/node_type without a session. Explicit arguments on this call take precedence over the handle.

tools.name: subtensor_preferences
tools.description: Get or set session preferences for language, node URL, and node type. Language affects field name casing (TypeScript=camelCase, others=snake_case) and code examples.

language.description: For set: preferred language. Affects field name casing in lookups (TypeScript=camelCase, others=snake_case) and code examples.

node_url.description: For set: WebSocket endpoint for generated code

preferences.description: Preferences handle from subtensor_preferences(action="set"). Carries language/node_url/node_type without a session. Explicit arguments on this call take precedence over the handle.

tools.name: subtensor_decode
tools.description: Decode SCALE-encoded hex into labelled fields with RAO→TAO and hex→SS58 conversions applied. Omit pallet and name to identify an event or call from its two-byte (pallet index, item index) prefix — the usual case when you have bytes and want to know what they are.

hex.description: SCALE-encoded bytes as hex, with or without a 0x prefix. Whitespace is ignored.

kind.description: What the bytes are: 'event' (default), 'call', or 'value' for a bare value of a given type

pallet.description: Pallet of the event or call. Omit together with "name" to identify the item from the byte prefix instead.

name.description: Event or call name. Must be given together with "pallet".

type.description: For kind="value": the SCALE type to decode against, e.g. "u64", "AccountId", "Vec<u16>", "Option<u32>"
